title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
lineage: MAC > Sony TC-KA3ES > Sound Devices USB Pre-2 > WAV 2496. Edits: WAV 2496 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Concert recording & transfer by Richie Stankiewicz, edits by Andrew F. 05/2014.
source: AUD: 2x Beyers M160's > Sony TC-D5, in the sweet spot.

ai_review.summary: A classic 1982 show captured with excellent sound quality, featuring Brent and Phil on fire and a jam‑filled finish.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers give the recording five stars, praising the crystal‑clear audio and calling it a classic performance. The concert is described as high‑energy with Brent Mydland’s keyboards and Phil Lesh’s bass blazing, plus an exciting jam to close the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews highlight a stellar performance and top‑notch recording; the limited sample size keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers explicitly praise the sound as great/crisp with no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic flow with strong jams and tight transitions, ending on a memorable jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Moved from left to right side of the stage, noted by reviewer.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as 'on fire' and creating a 'phil zone'.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland praised for fiery playing at the end of the show.
